}}The woman who tamed [[Jain Farstrider]] in a [[Gleeman]]’s tale. [[Thom Merrilin]] offers this as one of the tales he will tell when he first arrives in [[Emond's Field]].{{ref/book|1|4}}

It is not known if this was ever a real person or not. Jain mentions that he had a wife who died of a fever while he was exploring the world, but whether this was Susa or not is up for speculation.{{ref/book|11|6}}
